Mizuki is ABIS's new Special Agent. A Psyncer who uses the Psync machine to infiltrate the brains of suspects and key witnesses. Mizuki lost her left eye and is now fitted with a replacement eye equipped with advanced artificial intelligence (the AI-Ball "Aiba"). Despite still being a high school student, her strong physical abilities and clever mind have earned her a special accommodation in ABIS.
From official press release and in-game character description
It is revealed that Mizuki Date is a clone of Mizuki Kuranushi, and her genes were altered by Chikara Horadori, which gives her superhuman strength.

A highly educated rich boy hired right out of school. He lost his parents in a plane crash when he was young. He had been living with his younger brother until he too passed away when he was still in high school...
Severely emotionally scarred from the case 6 years ago (he was already mentally unstable, but it got worse). Supposedly, he knows something important about the HB case.

The daughter of the uber-rich Chieda family. She is in the dance club at school with Iris and Amame. She is the most gifted singer and dancer in the club; she's even won a contest before. She calls Mizuki "Big Sis."

A former "Quiz King" turned comedian. His stage name is Andes Komeji. He has made some TV appearances but isn’t very successful. His money troubles led to a divorce from his wife, and he now lives with his son Shoma.
Komeji is the last victim killed in the HB Case in the Past, 6 Years Ago.
Profession: President of Naixatloz Japan Branch
Likes: Flow of Water, Flow of Time, X, Diamond Shapes, Bugs (Glitches)

The President of Naix Japan. A believer in Simulation Theory, she sincerely believes that the world she lives in is fake and was created by someone. She has no interest in living a long life in this world.

She was coerced into an affair with Chikara Horadori for her position, and gave birth to Jin Furue as a result. Was involved in Uru's kidnapping, but became a mother-figure to him. She believes in the Frayer's existence and developed the Nirvana Initiative with Uru to break out of the Simulation and reach enlightenment.
Tokiko is the last "victim" of the HB Case in the Present, committing suicide for the Nirvana Initiative.
In the Butterfly Dream Ending, she reaches enlightenment and communicates with the Frayer, breaking free of the simulation.

A former thief. Until recently, he was working as a janitor but was fired due to his past... He fell in love with Kizuna Chieda after seeing her dance at Matsushita Diner. He gets rejected after confessing his love to her.
A former thief who now works as a locksmith. His feelings for Kizuna haven't changed.
He still regrets not being able to protect her 6 years ago...

He runs a restaurant called Brahman in Golden Yokocho. Since his face scares people, he usually wears a cute mask. So strong he could destroy a tank with his bare hands.
He still runs a restaurant called Brahman in Golden Yokocho. Nothing has changed. Maybe he's afraid of change.
Gen was the subject of genome experiments at Horadori Institute. He was born with a deformed face and body, and rough skin like rock.
Most appearances of "Gen" in the Present (except for Feb 13 or otherwise stated) is actually Kaname Date wearing a disguise.
A mysterious person. Appears to be female based on body shape.

A mysterious person who saved Mizuki. She says she's privately running an investigation on the genome research that was being done at Horadori Institute. She says her mask is glued to her face using a special super-powerful glue.
Likes: Ferris Wheels, Robots, a Certain Girl From His School,
Komeji’s son. He despises his poor comedian dad. He likes being alone and doesn't have too many friends. He heads home right away after school to make robots in his room. In the same grade as Mizuki.
6 years ago, his father was killed by Tearer. Does he have something to do with the tire tracks at the stadium? He looks the same as he did 6 years ago...
Shoma is a subject of genome experiments from Horadori Institute, which has considerably slowed down his aging and growth, appearing as a 12 year old even at 18.
Profession: Director of Horadori Institute of Genetics

A brilliant scientist who established the Horadori Institute of Genetics at a young age. The institute mainly researches DNA treatment and gene therapy. He divorced his wife 6 years ago. His ex-wife and daughter now live in Italy.

Formerly a member of Naixatloz, he had an affair with Tokiko Shigure and is the father of Jin Furue. He kidnapped Uru Somezuki to cure Jin's illness. His cruel research into genetics —reaching for immortality— created the original Mizuki, her clone, and Gen. He also managed to slow down Shoma's aging and growth.
Chikara is the second victim of the HB Case in the Past, 6 Years Ago.
CEO of Music Food Co., Ltd. He held high positions at various other enterprises. He was also a writer and had released some of his essays to the media. His right half was found at Studio Dvaita.
Jin Furue was killed by Tearer 6 years ago.
He had inoperable tumors in the right side of his body and constantly received organs from Uru, ultimately his face as well.

He is the illegitimate son of Chikara Horadori and Tokiko Shigure, adopted by the Furue family. The right half of his face is Uru's, but the left half is his original, bearing a %-shaped birthmark. Any official photos of Jin are photoshopped to appear just like Uru's original face. The right half of his body (the one that looks like Uru) was found in the Past, while his left half (bearing his original face) was stored away for 6 years and found in the Present.
Likes: Quizzes, The Occult, Dance, Music, Voices, Right (Side)
Dislikes: Customers Who Sit There For 3 Hours With Just a Coffee, Silence, Left (Side)

She graduated from Sekiba High, but she still works at Sunfish Pocket as a Mermaid. Recently, she has had some health issues. She seems to know something about the Nirvana Initiative...
She is revealed to be the culprit of the present-day HB Case, having killed the original culprit, Tearer, as revenge for her father's death, and then blackmailed into aiding the Nirvana Initiative.
Profession: General Affairs at Chieda Foundation

6 years ago she was caught in an explosion that damaged her vertebrae, which left her unable to walk. She loved dancing, but she can't anymore. Sometimes she will wear her favorite shoes and try to tap a beat.
Dislikes: Anyone Who Messes With Mizuki Date

Mizuki Date was born from her DNA, almost like a little sister. She lived at Aioen until she was 9 years old. Mizuki Kuranushi secretly watched over Mizuki Date from afar, watching her grow up.
Edited from the in-game character descriptions

Bibi was originally taken in by the Chieda Family, becoming Kizuna's "Big Sis". She was adopted at 15 by Shizue "Boss" Kuranushi, then trained and admitted into ABIS at 18. She previously worked as a thief for the Kumakura Family, going by the codename "Quartz" and assisted by Lien.

Bibi is the protagonist during "Mizuki Chapter 2" and "Mizuki Chapter 4", both set in the Past, where she is 18 years old and looks the same as 18-year-old Mizuki Date in the Present. She is accompanied by Aiba in the Past and by Marco in the Present.
Bibi's AI-Ball during the present. They are shy, so they don't speak out often to the other Psyncers and AI-Balls.
Dislikes: Jin, Chikara, Those Who Impede the Plan
Skills: Knowledgeably in Molecular Biology, Electrical Engineering, Quantum Mechanics

The true identity of Tearer. When he was 6, he was kidnapped by Chikara and Tokiko from Aioen. He was held in the basement of Horadori Institute and constantly had the organs in his right half taken away, ultimately his face as well.

Uru encountered Amame Doi in the Past and believes her to be his "destiny." Six years later, he presents The Nirvana Initiative to an older Amame, who kills him as revenge for her father's murder. Uru, the main antagonist, is the first body featured in the game.
The prime suspect of the HB case. Wears an iron mask.
Dislikes: The Unemployed, Ignorance, Rude People, Day Drinkers
Hobbies: Gold, Sailing, Wine, Bonsai, Animal Flossing
Besides being the chairman of Aioen, he's an investor, philanthropist, founder of the Chieda Foundation, and an honorary professor. He funded the reopening of Horadori Institute.
Riichi took in Mizuki (Bibi) when she was 9 years old. He funded the Horadori Institute to research methods of curing Mizuki's heart condition.
A transcendental being that observes the Simulation. They perceive the story through the different protagonists of the game, and controls them to make choices as they traverse across timelines.

The Nirvana Initiative was created to trick the Frayer into traversing time between the Past and Present 4 times each as Ryuki and the two Mizukis, creating 4 Xs and allowing Tokiko to reach Enlightenment and transcend the Simulation.
Likes: Singing, Dancing, The Occult, Irises, Mizuki, Friends

. He's also close to Iris and Ota. One of his biggest concerns recently is how to deal with excessive sweating on his face and neck.
